# Xiaoyuan 14B — llms.txt

> A local-first, safety-gated agent architecture built around a quantized 14B open-weight model.

## What it is

Xiaoyuan 14B is an agent system, not a new foundation model. It wraps Qwen2.5 14B Instruct (Q4_K_M, served by Ollama) with four deterministic layers: scenario routing, high-confidence safety gates, task constraint blocks, and output post-check/repair. It is designed for local, resource-constrained deployment.

## What it is not

- Not a new base model or a claim of a new model architecture.
- Not an official leaderboard entry or a competition winner.
- Not a public always-on inference service in this repository.
- Not a substitute for a human emergency responder, clinician, lawyer, or financial adviser.

## Evidence (local, not official)

- 10/10 local tasks, 31/31 turns completed.
- 89/100 local strict self-score.
- 45/45 automated regression tests OK.
- ~9 GB runtime, ~4.9 tokens/s, 4k working context.
